Author: Isaiahfeldt
Name: Auto Grit
Punchline: Configurable tank stance for combat and duties.
Description: Activates the appropriate tank stance on combat or PvE duty entry, including dungeons, trials, raids, and roulette destinations. Includes per-job switches, activation delays, an optional other-tank head start in duties, retry duration, and chat messages. Configure with /autogrit.
Changelog: Added duty/combat toggles, per-job settings, activation and other-tank delays, retry duration, and optional chat messages. Duty entry now includes trials, raids, and other PvE duties.
